body: Triage (2026-06-27, for 11.0 epic #2364): **PARTIAL, no longer a hard no-op.** notify node delegates to MessagingService (`service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`); inbox+email channels + outbox/dispatcher register at kernel:ready. BUT it degrades to a warning-logged success if MessagingServicePlugin/email service is absent. Remaining: wire messaging into example templates + an e2e notify→delivery dogfood proof.
